import re, importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task_transform',str(program_file)); mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
def parse_demo_pair(text, n):
    inp_pat=f'Demo pair {n} input (28x28):\\n'
    out_pat=f'Demo pair {n} output (28x28):\\n'
    start=text.index(inp_pat)+len(inp_pat); mid=text.index(out_pat,start)
    end=text.find('Wrong attempts used:',mid)
    outtxt=text[mid+len(out_pat):end if end>=0 else None]
    def rows(s):
        return [[int(x) for x in ln.split()] for ln in s.splitlines() if re.fullmatch(r'[0-9 ]+',ln.strip()) and ln.strip()]
    return rows(text[start:mid]),rows(outtxt)
